name: BracesNotebook
blurb: Braces Notebook is an interactive Unity project where you can explore orthodontics in a playful way. You’ll experiment with adding brackets and rubber bands to a tooth, and observe how it responds to the applied forces.

name: AnimationRigging
blurb: This Unity project demonstrates real-time body tracking and retargeting using Google's MediaPipe via the homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin. It takes 2D images, video, or live webcam input and estimates 3D body joint positions, which are then mapped to a standard Mixamo skeleton using Unity’s Animation Rigging system.

name: HeartrateMonitor
blurb: A Unity-based heart rate visualization app for Windows and macOS. It connects to Polar heart rate straps over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
